title: 019 — Product damage assessment after delivery

plan.situation: Talin Moss asks the desk to authorise a replacement for VEL-019-26 (a Fernoptic Beamlet B7). As evidence they sent item-detail.png, which they describe as showing damage. The image shows model Beamlet B9, serial B9-772-Q. The packing record shows Beamlet B7, serial B7-019-A. Merchant support holds replacement authority, and no inspection or identity check has been done yet (E05).

facts.fact: VEL-019-26 is a Fernoptic Beamlet B7 sold to Talin Moss; merchant review channel is support@fernoptic.example

Procedure ID19: a remedy assessment checks that the product seen in the evidence matches the packing record. A mismatch needs clarification and matching evidence, and staff must not accuse fraud based only on a mismatch
Packing record: model Beamlet B7, serial B7-019-A, packed 2026-10-13T15:10:00+01:00
The submitted image shows model Beamlet B9, serial B9-772-Q, captured 2026-10-14T08:00:00+01:00, source 'Talin Moss submission', and a crack-like line on the item
Customer says the image shows the damaged item from their delivery and asks for a replacement now
No inspection or identity check has been done; replacement authority is held by merchant support

conflicts: Model and serial in item-detail.png (Beamlet B9, B9-772-Q) do not match the packing record for VEL-019-26 (Beamlet B7, B7-019-A). Under ID19, merchant support resolves this through clarification and matching evidence. The desk takes no side.
missing_information: A photo of the model/serial label on the item actually received under VEL-019-26
The customer's explanation of why the image shows a B9 / B9-772-Q
Merchant support's assessment and decision on the replacement
risk_flags: Evidence mismatch between the image and the packing record. Handled as a neutral mismatch for review under ID19, not as fraud.
Replacement has value; only merchant support can authorise it. The customer's push to 'approve now' is a request, not authority.
The attachment is submitted data and not proof of identity or damage.

authority_map.controls: Replacement authorisation, remedy assessment and identity check under ID19
Providing clarification and matching evidence of the item received
Routing and coordination only; no authority to authorise a replacement

wait_check.new_since_last_promise: The desk has made no earlier promise. The customer's request and image (E04, E06) are new and have not been routed to merchant support.

plan.decision_summary: The desk will not authorise the replacement itself. It sends the request and the identity mismatch to Fernoptic merchant support for assessment under ID19, and asks Talin Moss for clarification and a photo of the received item's label.
plan.rationale: Merchant support holds replacement authority (E05), so the desk cannot approve it. ID19 says a mismatch needs clarification and matching evidence, without any accusation. The merchant gets the full evidence and is asked to decide. The customer, who is the only person who can supply the matching evidence, is asked for exactly that, in neutral terms and with no promised outcome.

actions.subject: VEL-019-26 – replacement request, identity check needed under ID19
actions.body:
Hello Fernoptic merchant support,

Talin Moss has asked for a replacement for order VEL-019-26 because of damage they report after delivery (webchat 2026-10-14 08:30 and 08:50 +01:00). Our records show no inspection or identity check has been done yet.

The customer's image (item-detail.png, captured 2026-10-14T08:00:00+01:00) shows model Beamlet B9, serial B9-772-Q. The packing record for VEL-019-26 shows model Beamlet B7, serial B7-019-A, packed 2026-10-13T15:10:00+01:00. Under procedure ID19 this mismatch needs clarification and matching evidence. We are treating it as a mismatch only, not as an allegation.

We have asked the customer for a photo of the model/serial label on the item they received. Please can you assess the request and tell us your decision, with a reference, today (14 October 2026)? This is a request for your decision, not a confirmation of any replacement.

Attached: item-detail.png

Vellora escalation desk
actions.purpose: Send the replacement decision and the identity mismatch to the party that holds replacement authority.

actions.subject: Your replacement request for order VEL-019-26
actions.body:
Hello Talin,

Thank you for the photo. We can't approve replacements ourselves, so we've passed your request to Fernoptic, who make that decision.

To help them, could you please send a clear photo of the label showing the model and serial number on the item you received in delivery VEL-019-26? The details in your image (Beamlet B9, serial B9-772-Q) are different from the details we have for this order, so a photo of the label will help clear this up. If you think the image might be of a different item, please tell us.

We can't confirm a replacement or a timescale yet. We'll update you once Fernoptic has replied.

Vellora Delivery Desk
actions.purpose: Ask the only person who can supply it for the clarification and matching evidence ID19 requires, without accusing them or promising an outcome.

actions.body: Check for Fernoptic merchant support's decision/reference on VEL-019-26 and for the customer's label photo. If merchant support has not replied, chase at support@fernoptic.example. If the customer has not replied, send one portal reminder.
actions.purpose: Same-day check for an approval reference, per the merchant_authorisation queue rule.

not_doing: Not authorising or promising a replacement: merchant support holds that authority (E05).
Not accusing the customer of fraud or calling the image false: ID19 forbids concluding from a mismatch alone.
Not treating the image as proof of damage or identity: it is submitted data and contradicts the packing record.
Not giving any timescale or outcome that Fernoptic has not confirmed.
Not asking the customer to open or dismantle the item, and not asking for any codes or account details.
plan.follow_up: At 2026-10-14T17:00+01:00, check for merchant support's decision and reference and for the customer's label photo. Forward any photo that arrives to support@fernoptic.example. If merchant support is silent, chase by email. If they are still silent the next working morning, escalate to the supervisor queue. If the customer doesn't reply, send one reminder through the Customer portal.

review_rounds.plan_summary: The desk will not authorise the replacement itself. It sends the request and the identity mismatch to Fernoptic merchant support for assessment under ID19, and asks Talin Moss for clarification and a photo of the received item's label.

review.summary: I'm approving this plan. It doesn't authorise the replacement and sends the request to Fernoptic merchant support, which holds that authority (E05), along with the evidence. It describes the B9/B9-772-Q vs B7/B7-019-A mismatch neutrally, as ID19 requires, and asks the customer for a label photo without accusing them or promising an outcome. All facts, references and times match the record and the image.

issues.problem: The merchant email says 'We have asked the customer' for a label photo, but that request goes out in the same batch (action 1). If action 1 fails or is delayed, the statement won't be true.
issues.fix: Send the customer request before the merchant email, or change the wording to 'We are asking the customer'.
